plan.cpu: production stele_pcs PreparedSource::hiding_with (Policy::Two, blowup 2) then certificate() and verify_certificate(), on rayon's pool; the masked rounds as in E16-35 (stele_reductions::zk::claims::bench, now with E16-34's base-field rounds and lazy QM31 product)
plan.gpu: research/gpu-gating/masked/src/source.cu: M' uploaded, transposed to symbol-major on the device, inverse Circle levels on the head, bit reversal and 1/n scale, forward levels on the whole (twiddles from the host, RFC-0010 A2), leaves hashed one per thread with the keyed-XOF salts computed on the device, one launch per tree level; only the root is read back. The certificate stays on the CPU. One untimed warm-up pass per process.
plan.operation: hiding-source preparation (RFC-0013 A2/A8 policy 2, rate 1/4): M' (2R x 2C) Circle-encoded row by row (RFC-0010 A2), leaves salt || column hashed with BLAKE3 under the RFC-0012 A3 domain, the tree to its root; and the E16-35 masked rounds re-timed on main after E16-34
plan.parity: device roots equal the production PreparedSource roots: tests/source_parity.rs at (ell, m) = (4, 10), (6, 12), (11, 16) and the check mode at (11, 15), (11, 16), (11, 17); the masked parity test (2^20) also passed on this box
plan.source_shapes: ell 11 (2R = 4096 rows, the row exponent 12 of stories42M's two large sources) with m 15, 16 (the witness, C = 2^16) and 17; codewords of 2^(m + 3) symbols
plan.timing: per cell, the run with the median key (source: encode; masked: rounds total) of three; that run's other phases recorded

projection.gate: GO only if the measured resident ceiling is at least 3x (E16-36)
projection.method: Amdahl on bench/ledger/e16-36-dev-zk-stories42m-t32-mac.json laps (single run, 306.16 s): r = 85.44 s outside ADR-120's offloadable set; M = relations + ZK-GKR 175.64 s at s_M; source preparation 28.34 s at s_src; LogUp trees and tops + claim batches 16.74 s. s_src is the Mac CPU's (prepare + certificate) over (device encode + Merkle + the Mac's certificate) at the witness shape; s_M is against the box CPU (the Mac masked calibration did not run: host load 8-11), conservative because the Mac ran these rounds slower than such a box in E16-35
projection.trees_batches_ratio_needed_for_3x: 4.9x at the lowest measured s_M and the measured s_src
projection.verdict: NO-GO (ADR-127): with every stage the task measured on the device and the unmeasured offloadable stages on the CPU the ceiling is 2.65x-2.85x, and it cannot exceed 2.996x however fast the device is

note: E16-36 dev-zk GPU decision benchmark (RFC-0014 §1, §5; ADR-127). prover_time_ns is the sum of the GPU phases (upload + encode + Merkle for the three source shapes; upload + build + rounds for the six masked cells) from each cell's median run; per-cell GPU times are in stage_times_ns, CPU times in kernel_counters (ns). Device roots equal the production roots at every source shape. plan_digest is the SHA-256 of research/gpu-gating/masked/results36.txt. The commit is the main the box tree was copied from. The projection is an estimate, not a GPU prover measurement. Micro schema proof, verifier and control fields are zero: no inference evidence is claimed. Not a cost-model fit input.
